purpose: Fixed source-backed metadata expected on actual capture; no numeric or future-vintage approval.

INC_INC_011.source: sources/income-metadata.json: Household statistics, survey_period, Period effects

fields.population_group: Survey households with at least one member aged 18–64; households with all members outside those ages are excluded, including all-65+ households. Total regions and household types within that population.
fields.period_convention: June-quarter weekly-income snapshot collected during April–June; some components such as self-employment use the preceding 12 months. Not annual household income.
fields.limitations: Weekly snapshot values must not be multiplied by 52 to imply an annual household-income estimate. The selected household population differs from all New Zealand households.

fields.period_convention: Fiscal year ended 30 June; 2025 means 2024/25. A calendar-year release is not a replacement for this selected fiscal series.
fields.publication_status: Stats NZ announced on 11 September 2026 that fiscal-year prison releases are discontinued; calendar-year releases continue. The last fiscal observation may legitimately remain unchanged.

fields.period_convention: Fiscal year ended 30 June; 2025 means 2024/25. Calendar-year observations cannot silently replace this series.
fields.publication_status: Stats NZ announced on 11 September 2026 that fiscal-year criminal-conviction and sentencing releases are discontinued; calendar-year releases continue.

fields.index_reference: Year ended March 1996 = 1000; measured sector, not whole-economy labour productivity.
